items.title: Show HN: Getting AI Models to Wink – The Wink Test
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been trying to create long form GenAI films and found myself struggling to generate video of a character to wink. I found myself quite amused by the results. So I built a benchmark around getting video models to wink. Every model gets the same prompt and the same starting frame. Prompt: “She winks with her right eye.” Models tested: Veo3 / Kling 2.1 Master / Runway Gen-3 / SeedDance 1.0 Pro / Moonvalley Marey / Wan 2.2 / Minimax Hailuo-02 / Midjourney I've ran 9 random seeds for each model. It looks like Kling 2.1 Master is doing the best of this batch. Would love to hear other small, quirky things you've struggled video models to do — I’ll try to add them!

title_i18n.en: Show HN: Getting AI Models to Wink – The Wink Test
title_i18n.zh: 展示HN：让AI模型眨眼——眨眼测试
title_i18n.es: Mostrar HN: Conseguir que los modelos de IA guiñen un ojo – La Prueba del Guiño

excerpt_i18n.en: I’ve been trying to create long form GenAI films and found myself struggling to generate video of a character to wink. I found myself quite amused by the results. So I built a benchmark around getting video models to wink. Every model gets the same prompt and the same starting frame. Prompt: “She winks with her right eye.” Models tested: Veo3 / Kling 2.1 Master / Runway Gen-3 / SeedDance 1.0 Pro / Moonvalley Marey / Wan 2.2 / Minimax Hailuo-02 / Midjourney I've ran 9 random seeds for each model. It looks like Kling 2.1 Master is doing the best of this batch. Would love to hear other small, quirky things you've struggled video models to do — I’ll try to add them!
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我一直致力于创作长篇生成式人工智能影片，但在生成角色眨眼视频时遇到了困难。这些结果让我觉得颇为有趣，于是围绕让视频模型实现眨眼动作建立了一个基准测试。
excerpt_i18n.es: He intentado crear películas de larga duración con GenAI y me he encontrado con dificultades para generar un vídeo de un personaje guiñando un ojo. Los resultados me han resultado bastante divertidos. Así que he creado un punto de referencia para conseguir que los modelos de vídeo guiñen el ojo.
